title: 7 Signs a Godly Man Treats His Work Like Worship, Not a Sentence
caption:
Some men serve a sentence at work. A godly man treats it as worship, even the job he'd never pick for himself.

He shows up early enough that nobody has to wonder. He finishes the boring part without being watched. He does the job in front of him, not the one he wishes he had. He credits the team before himself, and fixes what he broke before anyone notices it's missing.

Colossians 3:23: whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord. That includes clocking out and actually resting.
